scope: Formal private Candidate, signed native originals, three-way Diff and explicit rebase, current-authority Validation and immutable ChangeSet/Job/Audit/receipts. Apply, Safe Apply and full frontend remain separate gates
matrix_boundary: Three upstream schemas loaded by the installed native CI OVS binary on each architecture; this is not qualification of three product binaries or all distributions/kernels

steps.name: Verify native architecture and Go formatting
Real filesystem exhaustion and durable recovery
Real systemd, Unix peers and isolated OVS forwarding smoke test
Real authentication, encrypted sessions and revocation across daemon restarts
Encrypted TLS identity, fresh connection confirmation and real recovery deadline
Native OVSDB inventory, identity reconciliation and upstream schema matrix

checks: unknown VLAN authority blocks validation even when its durable Job succeeds
reviewed local Port authority and discovered native schema produce an immutable typed ChangeSet, Validation, Job and Audit
real external VLAN change exposes Original/Current/Yours; explicit snapshot-bound rebase preserves history and invalidates old use
concurrent saves use strong CAS; dropped response bodies recover original receipts across both daemon restarts and provider outage without OVS writes
two real authenticated principals have isolated drafts, validations and receipts; current role revocation stops reads
unavailable has no fabricated generation; genuinely empty monitored DB is complete; discovered types, references, indexes and mutability
one snapshot for Bridge -> Port -> Interface, local internal port and Bond-as-Port; external VLAN changes retain identity and native empty-trunks semantics
snapshot-bound pagination rejects changed snapshot/scope; current token permissions withhold configuration fields
formal Candidate and Validation acceptance passed on the real HTTPS/IPC/OVSDB path; detailed checks in metrics.candidate_validation

fresh initialized DB with broken root/anchors creates a new generation; explicit manager restore revokes cookie and blocks old identity until reconciliation

actual hardened systemd unit validation
root mgrd and non-root webd communicate through credential-checked IPC and HTTPS
public OpenAPI v1, structured Problem and closed production authority
TLS-only listener and unavailable business API
mgrd SIGKILL: systemd restart, stale socket recovery, webd liveness and OVS forwarding preserved
webd SIGKILL: independent restart and OVS forwarding preserved
graceful management shutdown preserves both OVS processes, native configuration and packet forwarding
separate private web and manager databases preserve committed fixture data across both process restarts
missing/corrupt manager DB and corrupt web DB produce explicit 503 storage degradation without recreation or OVS impact
explicit root bootstrap, no key overwrite, manager DB/key inaccessible to webd UID
real Local login, secure host-only cookie, login Origin and session-bound CSRF; grant never exposed
last administrator protection and durable user effect/Job/receipt with one correlation
scoped Bearer credential, session separation and original-request recovery without secret replay
current role reduction immediately narrows existing sessions and tokens
two concurrent 64 MiB Argon2id logins under the actual systemd memory limit
independent mgrd/webd SIGKILL recovery preserves the sealed session and original absolute expiry
web DB forgery fails authentication; restoring an old valid mapping cannot undo mgrd logout
persistent security audit and stored receipts contain no password, cookie, CSRF or token plaintext
bootstrap HTTPS; invalid chain/SAN/private-key pair leaves serving identity unchanged
import replay has one Job; atomic trial requires fresh TLS connection confirmation; durable success evidence
mgrd/webd SIGKILL preserve original deadline; webd rolls back after 120 seconds while mgrd is stopped; failed Job retained
independent TLS/session/privileged key rotation preserves confirmed identity and original session expiry
missing key rejects recovery without regeneration; paired restore reconciliation revokes cookies and changes both request epochs
database snapshots, manager receipts, Audit and daemon journals contain no plaintext secret
